# pbs_subscription (Data Source)

Reads the subscription of a Proxmox Backup Server node as PBS last checked it, without asking Proxmox: `status` is `notfound` on a node without one. `pbs_subscription` sets the key.

Anyone signed in may read the status; the key and the other details need `Sys.Audit on /`, without which they are null.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pbs_subscription" "this" {}

check "pbs_subscription_is_active" {
  assert {
    condition     = data.pbs_subscription.this.status == "active"
    error_message = "The PBS subscription is ${data.pbs_subscription.this.status}."
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `node` (String) Node to read: `localhost` or the node's host name. Defaults to the provider's `node`.

### Read-Only

- `check_time` (String) When PBS last checked the key with Proxmox, in RFC 3339 format (UTC): up to about six days ago for an active key.
- `key` (String, Sensitive) Subscription key; null on a node without one.
- `message` (String) PBS's or Proxmox's message about the status, such as why a key is invalid.
- `next_due_date` (String) When the subscription is due for renewal, as Proxmox reports it.
- `product_name` (String) Name of the subscription, such as `Proxmox Backup Server Basic Subscription 1 CPU/year`.
- `registration_date` (String) When the subscription was registered, as Proxmox reports it.
- `server_id` (String) ID of the server the key is bound to, which Proxmox's shop shows.
- `status` (String) Status of the subscription as PBS last checked it: `active`, `new`, `notfound`, `invalid`, `expired` or `suspended`. PBS's daily update checks an active key with Proxmox again once its last check is more than five days old, and a key that is not active every day; PBS reports an active subscription `invalid` when its last check is more than 20 days old.
- `url` (String) Where to buy a subscription, or manage one, as PBS reports it.
